title: State how a test-ref remote gate relates to a candidate-commit landing
outcome: State how a test-ref remote gate relates to a candidate-commit landing
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md say explicitly whether a recorded test-ref full gate on the candidate's tree, with the same parent, counts as a candidate commit's final gate while the landing stays the candidate commit itself, or whether candidate landings need a local gate on the candidate commit
The change lands under the instruction-change conditions (a), (b) and (c), with a clean review pair and full gate
